name: Funny Nurse Life Cosmetic Bag
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Life Cosmetic and Toiletry Bag
metaDescription: A funny nurse life zipper pouch for makeup, toiletries, or work odds and ends. A handy birthday, graduation, or Nurses Day gift for nurses.
summary: A funny nurse life zipper pouch that works for makeup, travel toiletries, or the little things that rattle around a work bag.
whyItWorks: Nurse bags tend to fill up with small things: lip balm, hair ties, hand cream, pens, spare snacks, a phone charger. A zipper pouch keeps all of it in one place so it is easy to grab during a quick break. The funny nurse life design makes it feel personal and gives coworkers something to smile at in the locker room.

It is just as useful outside of work. Travel nurses can use it for toiletries on the road, and any nurse heading out on vacation can pack makeup or medications in it. It also makes a great base for a gift. Fill it with lotion for dry, over washed hands, a few lip balms, travel size dry shampoo, and a candy bar, and you have a thoughtful care kit for a birthday, graduation, or Nurses Day. Because it is budget friendly, it works for unit gifts or a nurse to nurse exchange where everyone sets a small limit.
